title: Another use case
caption: The same loop around a personal task: planning a week away for two.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The Vacation Workflow: five stages from a first plan to one recommendation, with the same checks between them.
readme.tryit: Open the Research stage, which repeats once per ticket. Use the Use case picker to switch back to the project plan.
readme.notice: The stages and their checks are authored, not fixed: a different task gets different stages around the same idea.
